title: Split rule origin out of self-id in the default rule contract
description:
`.jit/rules.toml` and the in-memory generator that seeds it, `default_ruleset()` (`crates/jit/src/validation/defaults.rs:95-186`), currently bake a rule's origin directly into its `name`, e.g. `default:label-format`, `bracket:coverage-preview`, and the doubly-colon-namespaced `default:namespace-unique:{param}` family. Colon must be reserved exclusively for the label `namespace:value` separator, so a rule's identity must drop the embedded colon: `name` becomes a plain colon-free slug and origin moves into a new sibling `origin` field on the rule.

Migrate the 9 current `[[rules]]` entries in `.jit/rules.toml` to this exact `name`/`origin` mapping:

- `default:label-format` -> `name = "label-format"`, `origin = "default"`
- `default:namespace-registry` -> `name = "namespace-registry"`, `origin = "default"`
- `default:type-hierarchy-known` -> `name = "type-hierarchy-known"`, `origin = "default"`
- `default:namespace-unique:resolution` -> `name = "namespace-unique-resolution"`, `origin = "default"`
- `default:namespace-unique:team` -> `name = "namespace-unique-team"`, `origin = "default"`
- `default:namespace-unique:type` -> `name = "namespace-unique-type"`, `origin = "default"`
- `bracket:coverage-preview` -> `name = "coverage-preview"`, `origin = "bracket"`
- `default:orphan-leaf` -> `name = "orphan-leaf"`, `origin = "default"`
- `default:strategic-consistency` -> `name = "strategic-consistency"`, `origin = "default"`

Update `default_ruleset()` so it constructs the identical colon-free names/origins in memory: the `"default:label-format"` literal at `defaults.rs:104`, the `format!("default:namespace-unique:{name}")` construction at `defaults.rs:150` (becomes the colon-free `format!("namespace-unique-{name}")`), and the `format!("<default:{name}>")` schema-reference/path string at `defaults.rs:285` (only the display/path string changes, not the schema content it points at). Give `Rule`/`RawRule` (`crates/jit/src/validation/rules.rs:948-961,1117-1126,1344-1372`) a way to carry this origin so it round-trips through `RuleSet::from_toml_str` and `serialize_ruleset`/`render_rule` (`crates/jit/src/validation/serialize.rs:163-186`), which must emit the origin into the `[[rules]]` block it writes, so a fresh `jit init` on a new repo reproduces the same migrated shape as the hand-migrated live file.

Update every consumer that matches on the old colon-prefixed literal so validation behavior is unchanged after the rename:
- `crates/jit/src/validation/serialize.rs:561` (test filter `r.name == "default:label-format"`)
- `crates/jit/src/commands/issue.rs:34` (`finding.rule == "default:type-hierarchy-known"`)
- `crates/jit/src/main.rs:1296` (`gf.finding.rule == "default:orphan-leaf"`)
- `crates/jit/src/commands/bulk_update.rs:899,931` (test assertions `.contains("default:label-format")` / `.contains("default:namespace-unique:type")`)

Also sweep the now-stale prose in `crates/jit/src/commands/batch_create.rs:488,573,738,752` and `crates/jit/src/commands/bulk_update.rs:894,926` (comments citing the old rule names) and the module doc-comment contract in `defaults.rs:15-40`. User-facing `docs/` prose (`docs/reference/configuration.md`, `docs/reference/labels.md`) is owned by separate documentation work and is out of this task's scope.

Update the pinned-string contract tests in `crates/jit/src/validation/defaults.rs:401-459` (`test_empty_registry_emits_exactly_the_unconditional_rules`, `test_fixed_default_contract_mf1`) to assert the new colon-free names in the same emission order.

## Success Criteria
- [hard] REQ-01: `.jit/rules.toml`'s 9 `[[rules]]` entries carry exactly the `name`/`origin` pairs listed above; no entry's `name` contains a colon.
- [hard] REQ-02: `default_ruleset()` (`defaults.rs`) constructs the identical colon-free names/origins in memory, including a `namespace-unique-<ns>` slug for every configured unique namespace (replacing `namespace-unique:<ns>`); the pinned-string tests at `defaults.rs:401-459` assert the new names in the same order and pass.
- [hard] REQ-03: a rule's origin round-trips through `default_ruleset()` -> `serialize_ruleset` -> `RuleSet::from_toml_str` unchanged (extend `assert_round_trips`/`test_round_trip_canonical_label_format_specifically` in `serialize.rs` to cover the new field).
- [hard] REQ-04: `serialize.rs:561`, `commands/issue.rs:34`, `main.rs:1296`, and `commands/bulk_update.rs:899,931` are updated to the new colon-free literals and their existing tests pass.
- [hard] REQ-05: `cargo test --workspace` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` are green.
- [hard] REQ-06: a repo-wide grep for the removed literal patterns `default:label-format`, `default:namespace-registry`, `default:type-hierarchy-known`, `default:namespace-unique:`, `default:orphan-leaf`, `default:strategic-consistency`, `bracket:coverage-preview` returns no hits under `crates/` or `.jit/rules.toml` (this excludes `docs/` prose, owned by separate documentation work; `.jit/invariants.toml`, whose `enforced-by` bindings are rebound by a separate downstream story; and historical logs under `dev/` and `.jit/gate-runs/`).
